en.title: Managing Team Roster Substitutions
en.excerpt: Official procedures for substituting team members, replacing injured athletes, and updating seeding totals.
en.content:
World Archery Substitution Policies

Club managers and team captains may substitute an athlete originally selected by auto-sync with an eligible reserve archer who participated in qualification, provided the request occurs before the official team manager meeting deadline.

Executing Roster Substitutions

To substitute an athlete:

  1. Navigate to Teams & Beregu in the tournament dashboard.
  2. Click on the specific team card to open the roster modal.
  3. Click Replace next to the athlete being substituted.
  4. Select the replacement archer from the club's eligible roster.
  5. Click Confirm Substitution.

Score Re-Aggregation & Seeding

When an athlete is substituted, the system recalculates the team's combined qualification score and adjusts bracket seeding positions accordingly.

Team Manager Meeting Deadlines

Once team brackets are published, team rosters are locked to prevent mid-competition substitutions.
